### What problem does this PR solve?

Issue Number: close https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/issues/17200

Problem Summary: loading schemas cause a lot of memory after analyzing the [AskTug](https://asktug.com/t/topic/34176) problem, especially the runtime memory, which is up to 2.5 GB.

we also bench the memory usage during decoding json, ([code](https://github.com/fzhedu/bench-json)), where 1000 tables costs more than 1 GB memory. This verifies the problem here, and it is necessary to decrease the concurrency to fetch schemas.

### What is changed and how it works?

Proposal: [xxx](url) <!-- REMOVE this line if not applicable -->

What's Changed:

How it Works:

fetchSchemaConcurrency controls the goroutines to load schemas, but more goroutines
increase the memory usage when calling json.Unmarshal(), which would cause OOM,
so we decrease the concurrency to 1. This would take more time to load schemas, but the duration is small, within dozens ms.

### Related changes

### Root causes
the go cannot release the memory during json.unmarshal() immediately, so in a for loop, the memory usage increases a lot.

- Need to cherry-pick to the release branch

### Check List <!--REMOVE the items that are not applicable-->

Tests <!-- At least one of them must be included. -->

- Manual test (add detailed scripts or steps below)

- workloads: loading the schemas/stas of tpcc workhouse=500  
- method: print the runtime memory usage
- results:

fetchSchemaConcurrency | Alloc(MB) | TotalAlloc(MB) | Sys (MB) | NumGC| cost time (ms)
-- | -- | -- | -- | -- | --
1 | 38 | 134 | 75 | 12 | 1280
3 | 43 | 137 | 75 | 12 | 630
5 | 47 | 137 | 75 | 12 | 499
8 (default value) | 50 | 140 | 142 | 13 | 276
10 | 51 | 141 | 143 | 13 | 219

- conclusion: 
decrease the concurrency to 1, the memory usage is minimal.
besides, with regard to the cost time, it is almost 1 s, and it is rather low, especially in constrast to loading stats(`["init stats info time"] ["take time"=8.711665424s`).

Side effects

- Performance regression
    - Consumes more CPU
    - Consumes more MEM
- Breaking backward compatibility

### Release note <!-- bugfixes or new feature need a release note -->

- decrease the concurrency to load schemas

issue_context.title: Optimize table meta to reduce memory consumption
issue_context.body:
## Development Task

Sometimes there're many tables in a TiDB cluster. e.g.
- TiDB is used for data warehouse
- in multi-tenant environment, each user has a database
For this scenarios, memory for each table should be limited.

However, TiDB always loads all tables in all schema at once in bootstrap, which can consume very much memory.
On the other hand, statistics info also occupies much memory, and it has been proposed in https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/issues/16572
In low-profile nodes with 8G or 16G memory, it always encounters OOM.

For the scenarios above, some tables are rarely used, so they can be loaded lazily and released after being idle for a long time.

---
See also #16572
